reviewer: Codex arm a, direct original and unresampled native crops

embodiment_body_ownership.evidence: The visible left arm connects from shoulder through elbow and wrist to the hand holding the curtain corner. The separate right arm ends at a relaxed hand beside the hip. No visible ownership mix occurs.

embodiment_joint_chain_and_reach.evidence: The left elbow bends naturally beside the torso and the forearm reaches the adjacent corner without crossing the body. Shoulder, elbow, wrist and fingers remain connected in the native contact crop.

embodiment_support_and_balance.evidence: Both bare feet contact the wooden floor, with an ordinary upright stance. The main sheet hangs from the brass rod through visible top loops, and the rigid marble offcut rests on the stool.

embodiment_contact_and_space.evidence: The left fingertips visibly pinch and lift the corner and the hand remains spatially coherent. However, the complete intended contact-state clause the thick stone edge curls around the fingers is only partially realized: the edge drops beneath the pinch, and an edge wrapping around the fingers is not clearly visible. This is an incomplete intended relation, not a diagnosed anatomical defect.

embodiment_visibility_and_projection.evidence: The full figure, both floor contacts, working hand, curtain folds, exposed mineral-looking cross-section and rigid comparator are readable together. Native crops permit direct assessment of the limited pinch contact. The missing finger-wrap relation is separately failed rather than inferred from the crop.

user_judgment.evidence: No requesting-user judgment has been received.

supplemental_observations.whole_image_impression: A quiet tactile surreal photograph: a recognizable face-and-hair reference, thick mineral-looking drapery and one normal stone offcut form an immediate material contradiction. This appearance does not prove real marble, ductility, deformation history or motion.
artistic_strengths: Subject face and curtain occupy complementary sides of the frame.
Gray mineral veins continue across broad soft-looking folds and a chipped thickness edge.
The normal rigid offcut and unused shears give a readable comparison and repair context.
limitations: The exact finger-wrapping curl is insufficiently visible.
The right edge of the large curtain is cropped, so the authored entire-curtain framing is not fully met.
Fine crystalline sparkle makes the mineral surface decorative; real material identity remains unproven.
supplemental_observations.reference_review: Short dark bob, fine bangs, dark eyes and softly rounded face are visibly reference-guided. This does not verify identity or actual age.
